none: PAS DEV-4003E8: Roman Republic Denarius serratu
contea di ritrovamento: Devon (Inghilterra e Galles)
D/ ROMA ; R/ L.ME (ligatured) MMI GAL

Roman silver coin. The coin is a Roman republic denarius serratus minted in Rome in 106 BC. Moneyer: L.Memmius Gal. Obverse legend: ROMA Obverse type: Laureate head of Saturn left; to left Q, to right, harpa. Reverse legend: L.ME (ligatured) MMI GAL Reverse type: Venus riding in biga right, Cupid flying left, above. Reece period 1 RRC p. 320, no. 313/1b
